search_text: published ZDI-13-270 ZDI-CAN-1785 ABB MicroSCADA Wserver wserver.exe EXECUTE Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2013-11-24 7.5 ['ABB'] ['MicroSCADA'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of ABB MicroSCADA Wserver. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the wserver.exe component which listens on TCP port 12221. This component user-supplied data directly to a CreateProcessA call. By supplying a UNC path to a controlled binary a remote attacker can execute arbitrary code under the context of the vulnerable process. ABB has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: http://www05.abb.com/global/scot/scot229.nsf/veritydisplay/41ccfa8ccd0431e6c1257c1200395574/$file/ABB_SoftwareVulnerabilityHandlingAdvisory_ABB-VU-PSAC-1MRS235805.pdf ['2013-02-13 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2013-11-24 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Brian Gorenc HP Zero Day Initiative https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-13-270/
